legacy_platform_triad.definition: three 256 MiB float arrays (768 MiB aggregate footprint), static OpenMP initialization and 50 ms minimum pass batches; logical bytes include 2 reads + 1 write

new_memory_calibration_dram_footprint.definition: three independent 8 MiB double arrays per worker (24 MiB/worker; 1.5 GiB total at 64), per-worker static first-touch, fixed calibrated passes >=0.1 s
new_memory_calibration_dram_footprint.comparison_warning: This is a distinct probe with different type, working-set partitioning, runtime/timer protocol and first-touch placement. Its rate must not replace the legacy 768 MiB platform triad baseline without an explicit reconciliation.

interpretation.sd: sample standard deviation (n-1), over the three timed reps; warmup excluded
interpretation.timer_scope: synchronized worker kernel interval excludes allocation/init/tile config/checksum/free; 80ms target, warmup+3 reps; does not time GEMM API
interpretation.worker_input_footprint_scope: worker_input_bytes excludes local output/scratch; MIX p6/p21 uses 192KiB input planes, active strided C8KiB, micro4KiB; physical cache residency not measured
interpretation.physical_traffic_warning: logical_bytes / logical_B_per_s are instruction-payload accounting; no PMU cache misses or physical DRAM traffic were measured
interpretation.no_reconstruct_warning: instrumentation hypothesis only, not numerically equivalent public GEMM
interpretation.amx_permission: CPUID AMX_BF16/TILE and per-worker Linux XCOMP permission
interpretation.reconstruction_ops: For mixed P6/P21, derived total_ops adds 1024 FP64 additions per component-product output; CSV's reported amx_or_add_ops_per_s counts AMX work only. FP32 six-mix adds 1024 reconstruction additions once per six-product unit.
interpretation.local_stack: Local reserves 4 KiB micro + 36 KiB FP64 block + 18 KiB FP32 block = 58 KiB per worker (plus ABI/compiler stack state). Active FP64 reconstruction touches 4 KiB micro and 8 KiB C; active FP32 reconstruction touches 4 KiB micro and 4 KiB C. The 196608-byte P6/P21 worker_input_bytes excludes these local arrays.
